You are @architect. Create a new slice for the RenderingEngine implementation layer. The architecture.md already defines the RenderingEngine contract (renderQuestion, renderAnswer with type dispatch for text/svg/audio/composite). This slice must cover:

1. TextRenderingEngine implementation — renders card.front as text, handles single-line and multi-line content (\n breaks for Conjugaisons FR)
2. Renderer dispatch logic — switch on ComputedAnswer.type to route to TextRenderer, SvgRenderer, AudioRenderer, or CompositeRenderer
3. SVG renderer stub — placeholder div ready for VexFlow integration
4. Audio renderer stub — placeholder play button ready for Tone.js integration
5. ScoreRenderingEngine — integrates renderScore (VexFlow SVG) and playScore (Tone.js audio)
6. Engine registry — resolves theme.renderingEngine ?? TextRenderingEngine at session start
7. Integration with FlashcardDisplay or ScoreCard components

Read the following files for context before producing the slice:
- apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md (RenderingEngine Contract section)
- apps/flashcards/docs/how/rendering-analysis-existing-themes.md
- apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-8-response-engine-framework/slice.md
- apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-3-theme-response-engine/epic.md
- apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-3-theme-response-engine/user-stories/us-019-rendering-contract.md

Produce the slice file at: apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-14-rendering-engine/slice.md
Use the template from .oneticket/templates/slice.md.
The slice must include: Goal, Related Epics, Related User Stories (US-019), Impacted Components, Interfaces, Sequence Flow, and Observability Impact.

Also update these existing files to reference the new slice (filename only, no ../ paths):
- apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-3-theme-response-engine/epic.md — add slice-14 to ## Related Slices
- apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-3-theme-response-engine/user-stories/us-019-rendering-contract.md — add slice-14 to ## Related Slices
- apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md — add RenderingEngine registry to Modules table if not present, add useRenderingEngine to Hooks table if not present
